offering_description.value: Provides international remittance services, mainly for immigrants sending money from the US, Canada, Spain and other countries to families in Latin America, Africa and Asia. Transfers are sold through independent agent locations, company-owned stores, and online and mobile channels, using its own technology platform and payout partners.

primary_services.value: international money transfers; foreign currency exchange; bill payment and related payment services

customer_segment.value: B2C: immigrant consumers sending money to family abroad

end_markets.value: remittances; consumer financial services; cross-border payments

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees per money transfer; other: foreign exchange spread on currency conversion

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes consumer funds via agents and digital channels and delivers payouts through bank and cash-pickup partners

geography_served.value: global: Send from US, Canada, Europe and other countries, receive in Mexico, Central America, Caribbean, Africa and Asia

specialization.value: niche specialist: consumer remittance and related money transfer services

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent agent locations such as grocery and convenience stores; online: mobile app and website transfers; own locations: company-owned stores

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed money transmitter subject to state licensing, FinCEN, CFPB, anti-money-laundering and foreign regulators

notes: Ownership may have changed recently; description reflects known operations.
